description: Change a conference's name, dates, venue or URL slug. Send only what changes — anything omitted is left as it is, and an empty string clears an optional field. Use it when the user wants to correct or fill in details of a conference that already exists; get the eventId from list_my_events first. Dates are calendar days in the conference's own timezone, so "2027-06-01" means that date locally. Changing the slug changes the public URL, so confirm that with the user before doing it. Requires the user to be an admin of that specific conference — being an owner of the organization is not enough, and a 403 says so. Needs an OAuth connection rather than an API key. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changes the public URL — confirm first.

startDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), in the conference's timezone.

name: update_conference
title: Update a conference's details
